title: Homology descent of nonnegative tensor cochain morphisms
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, A, B and C nonnegative cochain complexes of R-modules and h a cochain morphism from the total tensor complex of A and B to C. For p,q natural numbers there exists an R-bilinear map H^p(A) × H^q(B) → H^{p+q}(C). For cycles a,b,c whose underlying elements satisfy c = h(a tensor b) in the (p,q) summand, it sends the classes of a,b to the class of c. Cycle classes use def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data. No field, flatness, boundedness or sheaf assumptions are needed.

source.place: Tensor product of cocycles; Tag 07MB, signed total tensor differential

proof.text: Include tensors of cycles in the total tensor complex, and lift them uniquely to its cycles by the signed Leibniz identity. Boundary tensors have zero homology class: a primitive in the first variable gives a primitive tensor, while a primitive in the second variable gives one up to the invertible Koszul sign. At degree zero the corresponding incoming differential is zero. Descend the bilinear map through the homology cokernels in each variable. Compose with H(h); naturality of homology projection and injectivity of the inclusion of target cycles give the asserted formula.

lean.statement:
theorem natCochain_pairing_descent {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (A B C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ)
    (h : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R))
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶ C) (p q : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : A.homology p →ₗ[R] B.homology q →ₗ[R] C.homology (p + q),
      ∀ (a : (A.sc p).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (b : (B.sc q).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (c : (C.sc (p + q)).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K),
        c.val = h.f (p + q)
          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R))
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q (p + q) rfl (a.val ⊗ₜ[R] b.val)) →
        t (cupCycleClass A p a) (cupCycleClass B q b) = cupCycleClass C (p + q) c
